variants.specifics: Brackenford: A pointer to the inn, the gate news said again, and a comic brush-off from a man counting chickens.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: If it's news you want, go to the Drowned Lantern, down by the water.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Did you hear? The north gate's been shut on account of those bandits! Nobody gets through!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Shoo! Can't you see I'm counting my chickens? One... two... Aw, now I have to start all over!

variants.specifics: Thrumm: Three townsfolk of Thrumm: Varn teases, Nella points to the inn, Fobb worries about the Golems.

rumour1.speaker: Varn
rumour1.text: Well, look at you, all shiny and clean. Come see me when you've got some dirt on your face, hero.

rumour2.speaker: Nella
rumour2.text: If you want a hot meal and a bed, the Deep Mug is just past the Great Hall

rumour3.speaker: Fobb
rumour3.text: Oh.... The Golems come up the shafts every night now. What will become of us?

variants.specifics: Tharn: Three folk of Tharn: Osk the net-mender brushes the player off, Fenna flirts, Brug thinks the Mayor too soft.

rumour1.speaker: Osk
rumour1.text: Leave me be. I've got nets to mend.

rumour2.speaker: Fenna
rumour2.text: My, my! We don't get many like you out here. Come and see me when you're done with that witch

rumour3.speaker: Brug
rumour3.text: Mayor Dremmel is a good man, but he's too soft! Gundar the Ferryman would have run that witch out of the swamp long ago!

variants.specifics: Durnath: Three townsfolk of Durnath: gossip about Lord Tavrin, a brush-off from a soldier, a complaint about the town's own folly.

rumour1.speaker: Nessa
rumour1.text: Lord Tavrin is up in the keep, waiting on somebody. He's been up there for a month! If you ask me, he's scared stiff of Ostrigan.

rumour3.speaker: Pibb
rumour3.text: We let that Wizard live up on the hill for years and nobody ever asked what he was doing up there. Not once! Now look at us.

variants.specifics: Tullin: Three townsfolk of Tullin: a complaint about the town's own folly, a brush-off, an odd light under the lake.

rumour1.speaker: Fishwife
rumour1.text: Everybody said don't bury the dead out on the island. Did anybody listen? No!

rumour3.speaker: Old man
rumour3.text: There's a light down under the water at night. Under it! I saw it myself.

variants.specifics: Quorran: Three townsfolk: Dobb frets about the Undead, Liss flirts, Wendt gives a tip about barrels.

rumour1.speaker: Dobb
rumour1.text: The Undead are out in the Bone Hills. That's what everybody says. What's going to happen to us?

rumour2.speaker: Liss
rumour2.text: My, my, a new face in Quorran! Don't run off too fast, handsome.

rumour3.speaker: Wendt
rumour3.text: If you're short on potions, smash a few barrels. You'd be amazed what people leave in them.

variants.specifics: Tor Vessa: Ilsa teases, Olm brushes the player off, Petrik states the trouble plainly.

rumour1.speaker: Ilsa
rumour1.text: Ooh! Are all the men down south as big as you?

rumour3.speaker: Petrik
rumour3.text: The dead walk on the pass at night. Grisla the Frost Witch calls them up out of the snow.

variants.specifics: Kildrun: Three townsfolk of Kildrun: Hilde warns of the Lower Forges, Tobin brushes the player off toward the Guild Hall, Bolgo repeats the Demon news as a joke.

rumour1.speaker: Hilde
rumour1.text: Stay out of the Lower Forges, stranger! The Ember Demons are down there, and they burn everything they touch!

rumour2.speaker: Tobin
rumour2.text: Can't talk now, I've got ore to haul. Try the Guild Hall, up the hill.

rumour3.speaker: Bolgo
rumour3.text: Ember Demons in the Great Forge, did ya hear? Bah! My wife's cooking is hotter than any Demon. Hah, hah, hah!

variants.specifics: Harrow Cross: Wenlow warns of the dead on the roads, Gimble brushes the player off, Mungo the drunk repeats Wenlow.

rumour1.speaker: Wenlow
rumour1.text: Stay off the roads after dark, stranger. The dead walk them now.

rumour2.speaker: Gimble
rumour2.text: Not now. I've got horses to feed.

rumour3.speaker: Mungo
rumour3.text: Hic! The dead walk the roads after dark! Ever'body says so. Well, I walk 'em after dark too, and nobody runs from ME! Hic!

variants.specifics: Vardo: Three folk of Vardo: an odd thing at the well, a complaint about the wall, a tip about potions on the north road.

rumour1.speaker: Tibbet
rumour1.text: Somebody keeps leaving turnips on the well every morning. Nobody in Vardo will say who.

rumour2.speaker: Marl
rumour2.text: Oh.... We should have built a real wall around this village years ago. Now look at us.

rumour3.speaker: Sorka
rumour3.text: I hear the Ogres are all over the north road. Take plenty of potions if you go that way.
